launch_container_with_local_launcher: create a LocalLauncher instance and launch a podman container with a scenario JSON file and provider env vars
exec_command_in_container: run a shell command inside a running container using the LocalLauncher exec method and capture stdout
copy_file_from_container: copy a file from a stopped or running container to the host filesystem using the copy_from method
stop_and_remove_container: stop a running container with a 5 second timeout and remove it using the stop method
wait_for_adapter_health: poll the gaia2-adapter health endpoint inside a container until it reports connected within a timeout period
